from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_date = datetime(2025, 8, 22)
holidays = {
    datetime(2025, 9, 12).date(),
    datetime(2025, 9, 29).date(),
    datetime(2025, 10, 31).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 13).date(),
    datetime(2025, 11, 18).date(),
    datetime(2025, 12, 2).date(),
    datetime(2025, 12, 24).date(),
}

def is_business_day(date_obj):
    weekday = date_obj.weekday()  # 0=Monday, 6=Sunday
    return weekday < 5 and date_obj.date() not in holidays

# Alternative method: Pre-generate all business days in a range
business_days = []
for i in range(200):
    current_date = start_date + timedelta(days=i)
    if is_business_day(current_date):
        business_days.append(current_date)

# Get the 84th business day by indexing
result = business_days[83]
print(f"ANSWER: {result.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
